svg.text: DORA with a reservation: where the MAC decides which address the printer gets

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The printer only asks when it boots, renews or is refused; the router relays the broadcast and stamps the scope; the server matches the MAC against reservations before it touches the pool.

svg.text: A device runs DORA only on boot, renewal or refusal, so a corrected reservation takes effect after a power-cycle. Controls: CM-3, CM-8, AC-6 (DHCP Administrators, not Domain Admins).

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Generalised design: no client names, tenant IDs, addresses or data. Icons are simplified originals, not Microsoft artwork.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
